feature:hooks.reason: Hooks run on the caller's own machine, so the server has no call to refuse; it publishes the switch and the CLI and desktop honour it.

code:allowMcpServers.reason: MCP servers start on the caller's own machine, and every local surface (CLI, VS Code, desktop) starts them through the agi runtime, which refuses a server the workspace turned off or whose host is not on the list and fails closed when a governed account cannot read its policy (apps/cli/src/cloud/workspace_policy.rs mcp_server_refusal). A cloud Code session configures no MCP servers, so the server has no call to refuse.
